# skill catalog index
<!-- derived by skill-atlas; do not edit. Counts overlap - a skill may appear under several categories. -->

planning(3) — shaping work before it is built - exploring intent, stress-testing ideas, writing plans and specs, breaking work into tickets — superpowers, brainstorming, executing-plans, writing-plans
implementation(4) — executing planned work - development loops, running plans, parallelizing agents, building prototypes — superpowers, dispatching-parallel-agents, executing-plans, subagent-driven-development, test-driven-development
debugging(1) — finding the root cause of bugs, test failures and unexpected behavior before any fix is proposed — superpowers, systematic-debugging
review(4) — judging finished work - code review in both directions, verifying claims of done before merge or completion — superpowers, finishing-a-development-branch, receiving-code-review, requesting-code-review, verification-before-completion
git(2) — version-control operations - worktrees, merge conflicts, branch lifecycle and integration — superpowers, finishing-a-development-branch, using-git-worktrees
architecture(1) — understanding and improving how a codebase or domain is structured, from module design to knowledge graphs — graphify
ui(1) — visual and frontend design - aesthetic direction, typography, distinctive interfaces — frontend-design
writing(3) — producing and repairing communication - documents, research writeups, prompts, teaching, handoffs — claude-md-management, superpowers, claude-md-improver, prompt-master, writing-skills
agent-tooling(9) — operating the Claude Code ecosystem itself - setup, skill authoring and discovery, automation recommendations — claude-code-setup, claude-md-management, skill-atlas, skill-creator, superpowers, claude-automation-recommender, claude-md-improver, dispatching-parallel-agents, skill-search, …
system-config(1) — configuring the local machine - desktop environment, window manager and OS-level settings — omarchy
